snippet.title: Console Archives and Arcade Archives 2 – Announcement Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Experience the thrill of extreme winter sports straight to your home with Console Archives Cool Borders, now available for Nintendo Switch 2: 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/console-archives-cool-boarders-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Or, battle your way through relentless enemies, deadly traps, and supernatural forces in a quest to defeat Emperor Ashtar in Console Archives NINJA GAIDEN II: THE DARK SWORD OF CHAOS. Play now on Nintendo Switch 2: 
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/console-archives-ninja-gaiden-ii-the-dark-sword-of-chaos-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Experience classic gaming at home! Rave Racer, Doraemon, SONIC WINGS Special, and more will be joining the Arcade Archives and Console Archives series. Stay tuned for upcoming releases!

#ConsoleArchives #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
